versions.content: The function EthSwt_GetSwitchPortMode shall read the mode of the indexed port of the switch. If EthSwtPort references an EthTrcv then the function shall additionally call the corresponding function EthTrcv_Get- TransceiverMode of the Ethernet Transceiver Driver.
